svg.text: PG-1 wiring, page 3 of 10: The gain pots -> their headers on the carrier board
Each pot has 2 rows of 3 pins: the row nearer the PANEL is gang 'l', the row nearer YOU is gang 'r'. Short wires soldered on the pot, female jumper
ends on the header (header names are printed on the board).
Steps (the number is on the wire):

PANEL) -> board 'in gain knob' header: pin '1 l' (3rd

PANEL) -> board 'in gain knob' header: pin '2 l' (2nd
Input Gain pot: pin 3 l (LEFT pin of the row nearer the
PANEL) -> board 'in gain knob' header: pin '3 l' (1st
Input Gain pot: pin 1 r (RIGHT pin of the row nearer YOU)
